translation.description: True when x is a labelled or SPSS-labelled vector.
translation.details: An SPSS labelled vector also inherits haven_labelled, so it counts.
translation.example:
from haven import is_labelled, labelled
print(is_labelled(labelled([1], {"a": 1})))
print(is_labelled(1))
